documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto delivered a record quarterly performance in Q1 FY27, achieving quarterly volumes of over 1.4 million units, revenue of INR 17,244 crores, EBITDA of INR 3,596 crores, and PAT of INR 2,999 crores. Despite experiencing input cost inflation of about 4.5% of revenue alongside supply chain, fuel, and logistics disruptions, the company maintained an EBITDA margin of 20.9%. Growth was supported by strong performances across domestic two-wheelers, exports, commercial vehicles, and electric vehicles. To address emerging capacity constraints, Bajaj Auto is undertaking a capacity expansion from 7 million units per annum to 9 million units per annum. Bajaj Auto reported record financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth across all business units and strong momentum in sports motorcycles, exports, and electric vehicles.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to increase export volumes beyond 250,000 units per month starting in Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

guidance.claim: The company aims to complete an exhaustive makeover of its 125cc portfolio within the next 6 weeks.
guidance.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to introduce two new brands in the 125cc segment later in the year.
guidance.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

guidance.claim: The company aims to expand the Chetak store network to 1,000 stores over the next couple of years.
guidance.quote: Now that constraint is almost disappearing, which will allow us to now really step on it and expand the network, which is at about, I think, 530 - 550 stores to 1,000 stores.

guidance.claim: The motorcycle category growth is estimated to slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects the domestic motorcycle industry to continue growing at a rate of 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus motorcycle segments.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects export growth tempo to continue in coming months and deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months. In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: The Spares business unit is expected to maintain its growth tempo.
guidance.quote: Outlook for it remains positive with similar growth tempo.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic two-wheeler industry registrations grew by 14% year-on-year during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry turned in a resilient performance as registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in quarter 1, though much lower than the 25% growth of quarter 4, but under the circumstances, a very healthy performance.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic motorcycle industry growth was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc segment, while 100cc and 125cc segments remained flattish.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc segment of motorcycles. The 100cc and 125cc segments were flattish, resulting in a motorcycle growth in the industry of 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Combined domestic volumes for KTM and Triumph reached nearly 40,000 motorcycles, growing over 50% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Together, KTM and Triumph delivered another record performance with combined domestic volumes of nearly 40,000 motorcycles, growing more than 50% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Chetak electric scooter volumes grew 65% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Chetak, electric scooter volumes continued to scale rapidly with 65% year-on-year growth, driving EV penetration to almost 25% of ICE scooters at an all-India level.

demand_outlook.claim: Three-wheeler exports achieved a record of 100,000 units in Q1 FY27, up almost 70% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Three-wheeler exports delivered a record of 100,000 units, growing by almost 70%, commanding a dominant market share of over 65% of three-wheeler exports from India, and our growth of secular across regions in mature as well as nascent markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, vehicle price increases, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness continued growth and potentially an increase in growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, the electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness not just continuity of growth, but perhaps a further increase in growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Post-GST rationalization, Q3 motorcycle industry sales grew by about 15%, with January sustaining at a similar level.
demand_outlook.quote: But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry. And our understanding is that even January is sustaining at a similar level.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand quality in motorcycles shows the 125cc plus segment growing faster, and the 150cc plus segment growing even faster within that.
demand_outlook.quote: Equally important is the quality of growth with the 125cc plus segment growing at a faster rate and within that, the 150cc plus segment growing even faster.

demand_outlook.claim: The Electric 3-wheeler segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry, growing at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

demand_outlook.claim: Pro-Biking brands KTM and Triumph registered record combined domestic quarterly volumes of over 35,000 units, growing around 50% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto is expanding its total capacity from 7 million units to 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Capacities have emerged as a key constraint to growth. So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The store footprint of the Brazilian subsidiary reached 75-plus stores and continues to expand.
capex_expansion.quote: Our store count stands at 75 top-plus stores, and it continues to be expanded.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto expanded its Chetak retail network to nearly 450 exclusive stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.
capex_expansion.quote: The scale-up was also supported by distribution network that expanded to nearly 450 exclusive Chetak stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.

capex_expansion.claim: The company currently operates around 50 joint KTM-Triumph showrooms and plans to expand to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto expanded the footprint of its L3 E-Rick product 'Riki' to 50 cities across North and East India.
capex_expansion.quote: Steadily, the footprint of Riki is being expanded to now 50 cities in North and East India.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin reached 20.9% in Q1 FY27, improving sequentially by 10 basis points and 110 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity cost inflation represented an impact of approximately 4.5% of revenue during Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Calibrated price increases in April and June enabled the recovery of nearly half of the commodity inflation impact.
margins_costs.quote: And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: Spares business revenue was steady between INR 1,700 crores and INR 1,800 crores with record margins.
margins_costs.quote: In addition, spares revenue was at a steady range of between INR1,700 crores to INR1,800 crores, providing a recurring support to overall revenues and profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points after taking pricing in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: And therefore, net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points. This is after taking pricing.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost inflation is estimated to be approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue in Q1.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA margin expanded sequentially by 30 basis points to 20.8%, supported by favorable currency, operating leverage, and PLI benefits.
margins_costs.quote: Margin performance during the quarter was supported by favourable currency movements, operating leverage and PLI benefits.

margins_costs.claim: Bajaj Auto's EV business delivers double-digit EBITDA margin as scale increases.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity cost inflation resulted in a net price versus cost hit of nearly 50 basis points on Q3 margins.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: Management anticipated a 50 to 60 basis point cost inflation impact in Q4 and implemented pricing actions to offset about half of it.
margins_costs.quote: At the start of the quarter, we had anticipated an impact of anywhere between 50 to 60 basis points for which we have taken certain pricing actions across the portfolio to offset about half this impact so far.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volumes reached a new record high of 732,000 units in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports business unit, the business unit established a new high of 7,32,000 units in the quarter and USD 735 million revenue in the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Electric two-wheeler monthly capacity was constrained at 50,000 units during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are right now at 50,000 units. We are limited at that for EV two-wheelers.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak capacity has reached 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volume grew 18% year-on-year in Q3, crossing the 600,000 units mark.
orders_capacity.quote: The business grew at 18% year-on-year this quarter in volume terms and more in revenue terms.

orders_capacity.claim: The Spares business unit generated nearly INR 1,800 crores in revenue in Q3, growing 18% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The Spares business unit, this highly profitable business came in at nearly INR1,800 crores this quarter, a growth of 18% YoY on the back of better distribution and portfolio management.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto holds a 70% plus market share in ICE 3-wheelers and over 85% share in CNG 3-wheelers.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow generated during Q1 FY27 exceeded INR 2,300 crores, representing an 80% conversion of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash stood at over INR 21,000 crores at the end of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto committed to a 100% payout ratio of FY26 profit of INR 9,825 crores via dividend and buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: And this time, because we've already committed, if you recall, in our last meeting, we've already committed to paying out 100% as our payout ratio of the profit that we made last year, which was INR9,825 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a payout of 100% of the profits made last year through a final dividend and a tender route buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto closed Q3 with surplus cash of about INR 15,000 crores and generated nearly INR 5,200 crores in free cash flow over 9 months.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores. It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: The company invested slightly above INR 2,300 crores over 9 months into its Netherlands subsidiary to fund the KTM acquisition and BACL's growth.
capital_allocation.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto Credit Limited achieved an AUM of over INR 16,000 crores and generated a PAT of INR 200 crores in Q3.
capital_allocation.quote: With penetration scaling to 45% levels, it has acquired over 3.5 lakh customers during the quarter and now has an AUM of over INR16,000 crores, and it has built a business driven by the twin pillars of digital first and robust operational management. It delivered a PAT of INR200 crores in Q3 itself.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain disruptions, raw material inflation, logistics issues, and a ransomware attack impaired overall product availability by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Bajaj Auto temporarily suspended operations for a few days to perform safety checks following a ransomware attack.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though exercising abundant caution, we suspended operations for a few days to complete thorough checks and investigations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Curtailments in industrial LPG supplies caused fuel availability challenges early in the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues in West Asia triggered force majeure declarations by suppliers and disrupted maritime logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, geopolitical developments in West Asia led to force majeure declarations by certain global suppliers and disrupted maritime logistics, resulting in tightness across key raw materials, particularly aluminum alloys and polymers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disruptions in emerging export markets such as tariffs, currency devaluations, bans, and shipping issues remain operational headwinds.
risks_headwinds.quote: And I always say this with a little bit of caution because disruption in the emerging markets and dislocations is a way of life, right from banning, tariff, currency devaluation, shipping issues, etcetera.

risks_headwinds.claim: The withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives in Electric 3-wheelers caused a cost impact of INR 23,000 to INR 25,000 per vehicle, which the company absorbed.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the withdrawal occurred towards the later part of the quarter, the impact was meaningful at approximately INR23,000 to INR25,000 per vehicle, and we consciously chose to hold pricing and absorb this impact in order to invest behind growth and accelerate volumes and our competitive position in this segment.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to complete an exhaustive makeover of its 125cc portfolio within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to launch two new brands in the 125cc segment later in the current fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to scale monthly export volumes past 250,000 units starting from Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to expand its Chetak exclusive store network to 1,000 stores over the next couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: Now that constraint is almost disappearing, which will allow us to now really step on it and expand the network, which is at about, I think, 530 - 550 stores to 1,000 stores.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to move export volumes to 2,20,000 units per month during the quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

management_commitments.claim: New product introductions in the Pulsar brand will hit the market as early as July.
management_commitments.quote: There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto will execute over 8 product interventions in its 150cc plus Pulsar portfolio over the next 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand joint KTM-Triumph showrooms to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto expects to start scaling up its Riki E-Rickshaw model beginning in quarter 1.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to start to scale up Riki beginning quarter 1.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto will fully consolidate the KTM business line-by-line into its financial results starting from the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: However, from the next quarter onwards, the KTM business will be fully consolidated into our results on a line-by-line basis as is required for subsidiaries.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
